topic: Dark Energy Surveys and Galaxy Redshift Measurement
product_key_hint: dark energy surveys galaxy redshift measurement
title: What Dark Energy Surveys Actually Measure: The 2026 Galaxy Stretch
description:
Most people think dark energy is a substance. It isn't. It's a measurement of how fast space itself is expanding. This short breaks down the exact metric used by major surveys like DESI and Euclid: the redshift of distant galaxies.

We look at the data that proves the expansion is accelerating, not slowing down. It’s a counterintuitive result that changed our understanding of the universe's fate.

#DarkEnergy #Cosmology #SpaceScience #Astronomy #Redshift #Galaxy #Universe #ScienceDocumentary
